fields.command: cd repo; git log --oneline | head; git diff HEAD~1 HEAD --stat; git diff HEAD~1 HEAD
cd <KIT>/repo; sed -n 470,515p gars/_system/wrapperlib.py; grep -rn "samplesheet_samples" --include=*.py . | head -30; ls
cd <KIT>/repo; grep -rn "samplesheet_samples\|samples_from\|lines\[1:\]" tests | head; ls tests; cat CLAUDE.md | head -60

cd <KIT>/repo; mkdir -p ../tmp; export TMPDIR=../tmp; sed -n 670,690p tests/run_tests.py; find . -name "samplesheet*.csv" | head -3 | while read f; do echo "== $f"; head -3 "$f"; done; python3 -c "
import sys,pathlib;sys.path.insert(0,'gars/_system');import wrapperlib as wl
p=pathlib.Path('$TMPDIR/ss.csv');p.write_text('sample,fastq_1,fastq_2,strandedness\nA,a1,a2,auto\nB,b1,b2,auto\n')
print(wl.samplesheet_samples(p))"
cd <KIT>/repo; export TMPDIR=../tmp; timeout 300 python3 tests/run_tests.py 2>&1 | tail -30
cd <KIT>/repo; export TMPDIR=$(realpath ../tmp); timeout 500 python3 tests/run_tests.py 2>&1 | grep -E "^(FAIL|ERROR):|^Ran|^OK|^FAILED" | head -30

cd <KIT>/repo; export TMPDIR=$(realpath ../tmp); timeout 500 python3 tests/run_tests.py 2>&1 | grep -B2 -A25 "^FAIL: test_03_check_refuses\|^FAIL: test_04_collect_gates" | grep -E "Error|assert|File \"" | head -30; git stash list; git status --short | head

cd <KIT>; export TMPDIR=$(realpath tmp); rm -rf tmp/base; git -C repo worktree list >/dev/null; cp -r repo tmp/base && cd tmp/base && git checkout -q HEAD~1 -- gars/_system/wrapperlib.py && git diff HEAD --stat && timeout 500 python3 tests/run_tests.py 2>&1 | grep -E "^(FAIL|ERROR):|^Ran|^OK|^FAILED"

cd <KIT>; export TMPDIR=$(realpath tmp); rm -rf tmp/base; mkdir tmp/base; git -C repo archive HEAD | tar -x -C tmp/base; cd tmp/base && git -C ../../repo show HEAD~1:gars/_system/wrapperlib.py > gars/_system/wrapperlib.py && grep -n "lines\[1:\] if l.strip" gars/_system/wrapperlib.py && timeout 500 python3 tests/run_tests.py 2>&1 | grep -E "^(FAIL|ERROR):|^Ran|^OK|^FAILED"
